title: Rogue Planets
subtitle: Worlds without a sun
description:
Episode 28 of a daily journey through the universe. 🪐
We meet rogue planets: worlds thrown out of their solar systems, drifting alone, maybe hiding oceans under ice, possibly outnumbering stars, and how we find them by bent light.

➡️ Tomorrow, Episode 29: Next stop, back home to the Sun.
Start from Episode 1 "Leaving Earth" on the channel.
Follow so you don't miss a stop. A new episode every day.

Images: NASA (public domain)
Narration: AI voice

#space #rogueplanets #astronomy #shorts #science

segments.text: Episode twenty-eight. Next stop... rogue planets.
Some planets have no star. They were kicked out of their solar systems, and now drift alone through the galaxy.
segments.headline: Planets with no star

segments.text: With no sunlight, they're frozen and dark. But some might hide liquid oceans under thick ice, warmed from inside.
segments.headline: Hidden oceans?

segments.text: There may be billions of them in our galaxy. Possibly even more than there are stars.

visual.label: of rogue planets in our galaxy

segments.text: They're very hard to find. We spot them when they pass in front of a distant star, and bend its light for a moment.
segments.headline: Found by bending light

segments.text: NASA's Roman Space Telescope is designed to find hundreds of them.

visual.label: to be found by NASA's Roman telescope

segments.text: Tomorrow, we come home to the star that keeps us alive. Next stop: the Sun. Follow, so you don't miss episode twenty-nine.
